name: D17 prospective enhanced-state separability experiment
purpose: identify whether deployable robot proprioception or simulator contact dynamics resolve D15-D16 commitment aliases before fitting another model
scope: the same 832 D3+D12 TRAIN groups and frozen primary folds; joint validation, DEV, and TEST remain unread

collection.alignment: warm-start-safe replay to each source snapshot and source contact step; existing 61-D state must match exactly

contact_channels.deployment_class: privileged simulator diagnostic unless supplied by force sensing/estimation

separability_arms.snapshot: unchanged D15 anonymous graph and action distance
separability_arms.snapshot_plus_proprioception: equal-weight scene, future-action, and fit-normalized proprioception distances
separability_arms.snapshot_plus_contact: equal-weight scene, future-action, and fit-normalized contact-force/impulse distances with consistent object relabeling
separability_arms.all_enhanced: equal-weight scene, future-action, proprioception, and contact distances

primary_subset: the exact D15 reference-positive, D14-predicted-nonpositive commitment groups

decision.arm_passes_both_axes: authorize one relational model using only the channels in the simplest passing arm
decision.only_privileged_contact_passes: record the observability limitation and do not call the resulting model deployable without force sensing
decision.no_arm_passes: reconsider whether commitment delta-BIC is predictable from available pre-rollout observations
